review.images: Reviewed the wide exact hero and four gallery assets. The listing shows the project’s own aerial hero over the linear park and surrounding homes. Preserved both published interiors.
review.location: Checked the named developer point, cluster map on physical page 6 and the brochure estimates on physical page 4. Brochure and general community site estimate scopes differ. Community comparison: https://www.emaar.com/en/our-communities/grand-polo-club-and-resort
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 15 physical pages and kept 12 complete layouts. The first three text-only exclusions are the cover and facade-style dividers on pages 2 and 7. All 12 drawings carry Equiterra 2 branding and position diagrams. Page 13 prints 2171.42 versus 2171.40 sq ft in components. Page 10’s metric total also differs from its metric components, while its printed imperial amounts reconcile.
review.cardSelection: 8 November 2026: Aerial view over the Equiterra 2 linear park (hero) now supplies the listing and developer-hero card cover, superseding the original cover selection. The aerial linear-park composition distinguishes this card from Equiterra’s pool view; the existing community-setting qualification still applies. Own source: https://www.emaar.com/cms-media/uploads/425754_property_Hero_Image_9fceac0575_prod.jpg. Only the card selection changes; original gallery assets, source attribution and image-scope qualifications remain unchanged.
